title: Hippos: Facts and Safety
excerpt: Hippos look slow and friendly, but they are among the most dangerous animals in Africa. Facts and safety tips.
body:
## In the water by day

Hippos spend the day in water to protect their skin from the sun. They produce a reddish secretion that works like sunscreen.

## On land at night

At night they leave the water to graze, sometimes walking kilometres.

## Dangerous

Hippos are territorial and can be aggressive, especially when you come between them and the water.

## Safety

- Never walk between a hippo and water.
- Keep distance at the water's edge.
- At camps, walk with an escort after dark.

## Where

Serengeti hippo pools, the Rufiji River in Nyerere, Katavi, Ngorongoro.
